### ArchitecturalFormatUSParser

```{python}
parser = ArchitecturalFormatUSParser()

# A trivial one-quarter of inch:
np.testing.assert_allclose(parser("1/4"),     0.00635)

# One inch and one quarter of inch:
np.testing.assert_allclose(parser("1 1/4"),   0.03175)

# One foot an one quarter of inch:
np.testing.assert_allclose(parser("1-1/4"),   0.31115)

# One foot, two inches and one quarter of inch:
np.testing.assert_allclose(parser("1-2 1/4"), 0.36195)

# Unusual representation of one foot and two inches:
np.testing.assert_allclose(parser("1-2"),     0.35560)

# Edge case, specified zero foot:
np.testing.assert_allclose(parser("0-1/4"),   0.00635)

# Edge cases, missing on side of the foot/inches:
np.testing.assert_allclose(parser("-2"),      0.05080)
np.testing.assert_allclose(parser("2-"),      0.60960)

# This gets parsed as two inches:
np.testing.assert_allclose(parser("2"),       0.05080)
```
